column1: # Shared step list. The bash runner (run.sh) implements these on Linux over a
# unix socket; the future PowerShell twin (run.ps1, not written yet) must
# implement the same numbers and names against \\.\pipe\podman-<name>.
# Exit code = number of failed steps. A failed step never stops the run.
